actions.action: Move plant to the brightest window (south- or west-facing) with several hours of direct sun
Rotate the pot a quarter turn weekly
Check soil dryness several cm down before watering
Water thoroughly when dry and let excess drain
Make sure the pot has a drainage hole
Repot into gritty cactus/succulent mix if current soil holds too much moisture
Cut off the top rosette with a clean blade, leaving 2-3 cm of stem
Let the cutting callus 2-4 days in a dry, shaded spot
Set the callused cutting on dry gritty mix
Give the cutting a first light watering after a few days
Identify the species and report it
